tooltip.quantumitems.window.shared: Shares one pool of items with its twins - use any, drain all.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.ground: Touching the ground breaks the link: the whole pool spills out here.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.automation: Machines extract ordinary items; taking the last one ends the link.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.shulker: Sleeps safely inside a shulker box. What you find on waking depends on the pool.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.lore: A splinter of somewhere else. It remembers being two places at once.
tooltip.quantumitems.shard.source: Found where the old city sleeps in the dark.
quantumitems.ponder.tag.quantum_entangle: Entangle item stacks so distant stacks share a single pool of items.
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_1: The ritual circle is built on a 5x5 floor of Amethyst Blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_2: Place a Resonator on each of the four corners
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_3: Each Resonator holds a single stack of items
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_4: The Quantum Core stands two blocks tall in the center
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_5: The space above the floor has to stay clear of other blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_6: Once the circle is complete, it is ready to entangle items
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_1: Lay a matching stack of items on all four Resonators
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_2: Then place a Quantum Shard on the Core to start the ritual
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_3: The Core links to each Resonator, then checks the stacks
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_4: If the stacks all match, they become entangled
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_5: Entangled stacks share one pool of items across any distance
quantumitems.ponder.ritual.text_6: The Shard is used up whether the ritual succeeds or fails
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_1: Entangled stacks can be stored anywhere, even far apart
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_2: They do not hold separate items - they share one pool
quantumitems.ponder.shared_pool.text_3: Take items from one and they leave the others too, never copied
